[[File:Scrubwort.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A scrubwort on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].]]
The '''scrubwort''' was a plant that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. This plant was frequently found on the banks of Endorian lakes.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The plant was also cultured in the atrium of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:TPS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>
